pages.title: Zinc
pages.text:
A common early metal, a step above copper.

- **Tier:** Copper
- **Durability:** 260
- **Sword damage:** 5
- **Armor (full set):** 11

pages.title: Getting It
pages.text:
**Zinc Ore** is common between Y 0 and Y 64, in stone and deepslate. Mine it with a stone pickaxe or better, then smelt or blast the raw zinc.

Zinc is also an ingredient in [Brass](entry://materials/brass).

pages.title: The Gear
pages.text:
- **Corrosion-proof:** all zinc gear (tools, armor, and shield) loses no durability while you're in water.
- Copper-tier tools can mine iron ore but not diamond or gold ore.

pages.title: Galvanized
pages.text: **Full set bonus.** Poison, Hunger, and Nausea last 50%% shorter.
A blast furnace works too, and is faster.
